name: AgroLens d.o.o.
about: Farm management software for mid-size grain farms in Vojvodina and Hungary: field records, spraying plans, satellite crop maps.
products: AgroLens Field (web and mobile); crop health maps
tech: Python; PostGIS; Sentinel Hub; React Native
challenges: C01-CH1: Farmers want a yield estimate per parcel by mid-June, but our maps only show crop vigour. | C01-CH2: Ground truth for soil moisture costs too much: probes are expensive and we can't place them on every parcel.
plans: Launch a yield-forecast product for 2027 and expand to Romania.

name: Polje Senzor d.o.o.
about: Pravimo bežične senzorske stanice za voćnjake: temperatura, vlažnost lista, padavine. Stanice rade na bateriju i šalju podatke preko LoRaWAN mreže.
products: PS-Orchard stanica; aplikacija za upozorenja na mraz
challenges: C02-CH1: Baterije u stanicama zimi traju upola kraće nego leti, pa voćari moraju da ih menjaju usred sezone. | C02-CH2: Voćari ručno broje leptire na feromonskim klopkama; hteli bismo da kamera na klopci to radi sama.

name: FreshPak Solutions
about: Packaging for fresh fruit and vegetables, mostly for exporters of berries to the EU.
challenges: C03-CH1: Raspberries for Germany arrive with mould on day 9; buyers want 14 days. | C03-CH2: Big retailers will stop taking conventional plastic lidding film by 2028; we need a compostable one that still seals.
past_collaborations: Tested packaging with a faculty lab in 2020.

name: Zlatni Klas Mlin a.d.
about: Flour mill near Novi Sad producing wheat flour and semolina.
products: wheat flour; semolina; animal feed bran
challenges: C04-CH1: We sell 18,000 tonnes of bran a year as cheap animal feed; we'd like a higher-value use. | C04-CH2: Electricity is our second-largest cost and peaks at bad times.

name: GridSense Analytics
about: Analytics for electricity distribution operators in the Western Balkans: asset registers, outage analysis, network planning.
challenges: C05-CH1: Operators want to know which distribution transformers will fail next year; they have dissolved gas analysis results and load data, but no model. | C05-CH2: Rooftop PV is changing feeder loads; operators need a day-ahead forecast per feeder.
rd_capacity: Five engineers, one with a PhD.

name: VoltCell Storage
about: Builds stationary battery storage from second-life electric vehicle batteries for farms and small factories.
challenges: C06-CH1: We can't tell how healthy a used battery module is without a full test cycle that takes 20 hours.

name: LinguaBot d.o.o.
about: Customer-support chatbots for banks and telecoms in Serbia.
challenges: C07-CH1: Our search misses answers because Serbian words change form (e.g. 'kartica', 'karticu', 'karticom') and users mix Latin and Cyrillic. | C07-CH2: Clients want the bot on the phone too; speech recognition for Serbian is poor on call audio.

name: CardioTrack d.o.o.
about: A 7-day ECG patch with an app for cardiologists.
challenges: C08-CH1: Too many false atrial fibrillation alarms when patients move. | C08-CH2: We need a clinical validation study in Serbia before CE marking.

name: InspektAI
about: Visual quality control for factories: cameras on the line, software that flags defects.
challenges: C09-CH1: Scratches on polished metal parts: reflections fool our model, and clients only have a few dozen defect photos. | C09-CH2: Clients want inference on cheaper edge devices than Jetson.

name: HidroLogik d.o.o.
about: Software for municipal water utilities: network maps, meter data, billing integration.
challenges: C10-CH1: Utilities lose 30–40% of water; they have pressure sensors in a few zones but can't say where the leak is. | C10-CH2: Forecasting daily water demand for pumping plans.

name: ReVita Water
about: Designs and builds wastewater treatment units for food and pharmaceutical plants.
challenges: C11-CH1: A pharmaceutical client must remove drug residues (diclofenac, carbamazepine) that our biological step doesn't catch. | C11-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
rd_capacity: Process engineer and a lab technician.
past_collaborations: Sampling campaign with a faculty in 2019.

name: BuildTwin d.o.o.
about: BIM modelling and consulting for public building projects.
challenges: C12-CH1: Cities want to retrofit 40 schools but don't know which to do first for the biggest energy savings per dinar.

name: RouteWise
about: Route planning and delivery tracking for couriers and retail chains.
challenges: C13-CH1: Same-day deliveries with narrow time windows: our planner takes too long when orders change during the day. | C13-CH2: Retail clients ask us to forecast store demand so deliveries match it.

name: SecureEdge Labs
about: Security monitoring for factories and building management systems.
challenges: C14-CH1: We need to detect unusual behaviour on Modbus and BACnet networks without labelled attack data. | C14-CH2: Clients ask whether our firmware signing will survive quantum computers.
plans: Certify under the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

name: Kredo Fintech
about: Online loans for micro and small businesses.
challenges: C15-CH1: Micro firms often have under a year of history; our scoring rejects good borrowers. | C15-CH2: The central bank wants every automated decision explained.

name: DriveCore Software
about: Embedded software services for automotive tier-1 suppliers.
challenges: C16-CH1: Writing ISO 26262 test cases by hand takes most of our verification budget. | C16-CH2: We need a cheaper hardware-in-the-loop bench for smaller projects.

name: PrintMetal 3D
about: Metal 3D printing service for tooling and spare parts.
challenges: C17-CH1: Porosity in 316L parts fails customer pressure tests in about 1 of 12 builds. | C17-CH2: Four printers, many small orders: we schedule builds by hand.

name: MlekoSmart d.o.o.
about: Ogrlice za krave koje mere aktivnost i preživanje i aplikacija za farmere.
challenges: C18-CH1: Farmeri žele upozorenje na mastitis pre nego što se vide simptomi.

name: NebulaQ
about: Quantum algorithms for drug discovery clients abroad.
challenges: C19-CH1: Error mitigation on today's noisy quantum hardware for molecular simulation.
plans: Partner with a quantum hardware vendor.

name: HempTex Vojvodina
about: Grows and processes industrial hemp into fibre for textiles.
challenges: C20-CH1: Our decortication line damages long fibres, which lowers the price we get.
